create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass with tf32, activation checkpointing, merge mole, and compile flags
build_inference_settings_default: build default inference settings with activation checkpointing enabled and tf32 disabled for general use
build_inference_settings_turbo: build turbo inference settings with tf32, merge mole, and compile enabled for long simulations
use_guess_inference_settings: use guess_inference_settings to resolve a string like turbo or an InferenceSettings object
review_MLIPInferenceCheckpoint: review the MLIPInferenceCheckpoint dataclass containing model config, state dict, ema state dict, and tasks config
